restrictions: Messages are 55 bytes: 52-byte group prefix P || 3-byte big-endian u (24 bits), one padded block, standard IV, 37-round complete hash.
2^104 independent uniform groups; each enumerates u = 0..2^24-1. N = 2^128 messages, one pass.

Seven messages per batch share P; rounds 0..12 run once per batch; rounds 13..36 run on a seven-lane 36-bit-slot SWAR word (proof.md Section 5). Conservative batch word-op count 2289 including table step; H2 asserts lane-wise equivalence to seven serial compressions.

140-bit table key is digest bytes 0..17 (144 bits) right-aligned in a 256-bit word; uninitialized sparse-set table with per-run tag (Lemma 4). Confirm with two reference compressions; at most 2^113 + 2^40 + 1 cold verifications charged.
Score-critical heuristics H1 (table/tail randomness) and H2 (SWAR equivalence). Generic search, not a differential attack.

heuristics.statement: Over fresh group prefixes and table tag, the probability of failure from (i) no digest collision among N samples, (ii) F2 overwrite before second probe of a colliding key, or (iii) more than 2^113 false 144-bit key matches, exceeds the uniform-model value 0.606 by at most 0.004.
heuristics.scope: The declared grouped message family, full 256-bit digest, 144-bit key prefix, sparse-set table on key bits 8..143.
heuristics.extrapolation: From organizer experiments cigts-mask-spread (32 messages, 16-bit mask on H3/H7) and cigts-mask-single-group (512 consecutive u, alternate mask) to N = 2^128 and 144-bit keys.
heuristics.limitations: Mask tests do not observe full digest collisions or 144-bit key saturation. H1 is not proved from experiments alone.

heuristics.statement: For any fixed 52-byte prefix and any seven 24-bit values u, the seven-lane program of proof.md Section 5 produces the same complete digests as seven serial 37-round compressions of messages P||u.
heuristics.scope: Single-block 55-byte messages sharing W0..W12; lanes isolated in 36-bit slots; schedule extension for W13-dependent words as specified.
heuristics.extrapolation: Static straight-line program; trial 0 of experiments checks reference digests on three u only, not all 2^24 values per group.
heuristics.limitations: Full domain equivalence is argued in proof, not exhaustively executed. Mis-implementation would refute the claim.
